domains where patenting is key. The consequence of this focus
is that this study only investigates specific, more technologybased aspects of smart specialization. Although these specific
aspects are of high importance in the smart specialization literature (D’Adda et al., 2019; Natalicchio et al., 2021), they limit

organizational innovations are excluded. This limitation implies,

industries or social service are completely or at least mainly
